results.title: Splinters (Short)
results.overview: Dropped by her label and lost in the world, a failed musician heads to her hometown for the first time in seven years. But as hard as she tries she no longer fits in to a world that has left her behind.

results.title: TNA Hall of Fame 2025
results.overview: The TNA Hall of Fame is a hall of fame that honors professional wrestlers and wrestling personalities who contributed to the history of the American based professional wrestling promotion Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA).  It was established in 2012, and created as part of the celebration of the promotion's 10th anniversary. Inductees are usually announced at either the Slammiversary pay-per-view event or on episodes of TNA Impact!, and the ceremony takes place prior to Bound for Glory. It has been an annual tradition for TNA since 2012 with the exception of two years (2017 and 2019).  As of 2025, there have been 16 inducted in total; 13 individually, and two group inductions

results.title: Valentina
results.overview: A young valentine unleashes her fiery rage

results.title: Junior
results.overview: A free-spirited young man suffocated by his father’s obsessive love escapes to the city in search of freedom, but his carefree attitude soon puts him at odds with his emotionally distant corporate boss. He embarks on a heartwarming journey of redemption and connection discovering the true depth of sacrifice love and the fleeting nature of time.

results.title: Little Did I Know
results.original_title: Det är något som inte stämmer
results.overview: Petra's seemingly perfect life unravels when her husband has an affair. Meanwhile, young Petra embarks on finding true love. Two women's journeys of self-discovery span different life stages, offering a hopeful yet painful view on love.

results.title: Alike
results.overview: After landing a role, a young actress faces an unusual request from the director that blurs the line between art and submission.

results.title: Smart Rabbit Momo: The Big Chase
results.overview: The story of Momo, a rabbit who lives in the Singing Forest, and his struggle to save his friends.

results.title: Beyond Detention
results.overview: A group of delinquent boys are sentenced to a wilderness challenge on a remote island, but become stranded. As civilization disappears, their detention becomes a game of survival - with each other, and with the unexpected.

results.title: Mistress for Hire
results.overview: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric's wife, Octavia, won't allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

results.title: Mañana Sí
results.overview: After his wife’s death, a man is interrogated by the State. Returning to a dystopic, totalitarian life, he weighs stifling his grief against leaving it all behind. A call leads an official to help him find his beloved.

results.title: Mo Salah: Never Give Up
results.overview: The story of Mo Salah’s unlikely rise to global stardom - how the Liverpool icon defied the odds and never gave up on his challenging journey to the top.

results.title: The Man Without Qualities
results.overview: At his beloved restaurant, Brian sits down with John only to witness John begin to mirror him in real time - his appearance, voice, even gestures - until the two are indistinguishable. As the night unfolds, Brian unravels in a nightmarish fit of existential anguish.

results.title: Love Is a Book
results.overview: The film consists of two love stories, "First, Second, Third" and "Love is a Book".  The former tells the story of two male lovers who start with a sexual relationship, develop feelings, and then openly share their emotions, leading to a deep connection. The latter revolves around two female lovers, reuniting after a long separation, experiencing a surge of past emotions and the inevitable clash with present realities.  Love is a book, and while they are in different chapters of their emotional journeys, both stories share similar, ambiguous, and pure expressions of love.

results.title: Amour Bleu
results.overview: Two young lovers hesitate to take their relationship further. One is blue, and permanently shares her color with anyone who touches her.

results.title: Yonne
results.overview: Morvan, 1842: forced to pass themselves off as men in order to reach Paris, two sisters embark on an eventful raft journey among the log drivers.

results.title: War and Music
results.overview: The war burst into the peaceful life of three friends suddenly, forever changing their destinies. Each of them went to the front, leaving the most valuable things at home in order to fight for this most valuable thing. Surprisingly, they are helped to survive in this fiery hell of battles with fascism, music. Taking musical instruments with them, friends play to maintain the morale of fellow soldiers, as well as to compose the leitmotif of Victory so desired by all.

results.title: No Limits: The Story of Leah Goldstein
results.original_title: No Limits: The Story of Leah Goldstein
results.overview: The life of Leah Goldstein, a champion kickboxer, undercover operative, and endurance cyclist, is explored in this feature documentary as she attempts to break the record in the world’s most intense bicycle race, the Race Across America.

results.title: Chalo Bulaava Aaya Hai
results.overview: After getting lost in the wilderness, a man befriends a group of tourists travelling to a temple.

results.title: Journey Home, David Gulpilil
results.overview: A powerful record of grief, community and ceremony in which the renowned Indigenous actor is laid to rest on his Homeland of Gupulul in Arnhem Land, NT.

results.title: Anamocot
results.overview: After a 20-year long fruitless search in the Cameroonian forest, Frenchman Michel Ballot is on the verge of giving up his lifelong quest to find the mysterious creature known as the Mokélé-Mbembé. Turning to local initiates for help, and torn between ancestral wisdom and scientific evidence, he embarks on a final journey into powers, knowledge and the unseen.
